llm.evidence: The HPLC system was coupled to Orbitrap Fusion mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific) through a Nanospray Flex Ion Source.
Precursor intensity-based protein quantification was done essentially as described in earlier publications by calculating iBAQ (intensity-Based Absolute Quantification) values.
Overnight on-bead digestion of affinity-purified (AP) complexes was performed using 500 ng trypsin in 20 mM Tris–HCl pH8.0 at 37°C.
The tagged mtRPs together with their associated proteins were purified by two techniques: conventional immunoprecipitation (IP) and rapid single-step affinity purification (AP)
analyzed in the linear ion trap with a target value of 1e4 and a normalized collision energy at 30 V
20 mM MgCl2, 2.5 mM DTT, 30 mM Tris–HCl pH7.6 and 1× cOmplete EDTA-free
